hook2: One pan. Rice on the side.
title: Lemon Butter Baked Cod
steps:
Rice on. Oven to 400.
Green beans + butter,
salt, pepper on a pan

Cod on the pan.
Butter, garlic,
lemon slices on top

Bake 15 minutes
until it flakes.
Rice on the side
vo: Fish night, done in about thirty minutes, on one pan.
Lemon butter baked cod with green beans.
You need cod, green beans, butter, garlic, two lemons and white rice.
Start the rice. Heat the oven to four hundred, and toss the green beans with melted butter, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Add the cod, then top it with butter, garlic and lemon slices.
Bake about fifteen minutes, until the cod flakes easily. Serve the rice on the side.
